subject: LedgerWave trial: prompts & log handoff, evaluation gates and timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@ledgerwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-07T15:12:00Z
Subject: LedgerWave trial: prompts & log handoff, evaluation gates and timeline

Hi Samir —

Great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before the POC kickoff. I’ve summarized the success criteria and the data handoff we discussed so the trial team can start planning ingestion and eval work.

1) Trial goals / success criteria (confirmed on call)
- Functional: extract & classify customer intents from support queries with >= 92% macro-F1 on our eval set.
- Latency: p95 inference <= 350ms for your expected query sizes (avg 240 tokens).
- Operational: end-to-end throughput of 50 reqs/s sustained for 30 minutes without dropped requests.
- Business: model answers must not hallucinate 1) pricing terms and 2) customer IDs more than 2% of the time (we will flag these in the eval).

2) What we need from LedgerWave to run the eval (deliverables)
- Sample prompts: 200 anonymized examples representative of your top intents. CSV/JSON (one prompt per row), include label for intent if available.
- Production query logs: 2 weeks of search/support query logs (timestamp, user_id hash, query_text, response_id if available). Redaction ok — please replace PII with stable hashes.
- Success contacts: primary data owner (for questions) and procurement contact for legal/PO.

3) Suggested delivery & timeline
- Data sample (prompts + one week logs) due: 2026-10-13
- Full log handoff (S3) due: 2026-10-18
- Trial kickoff (ingest + baseline eval): week of 2026-10-18 (we recommend Tue 10/19)
- Interim results & tuning window: 10/21–10/28
- Final readout & recommendations: target 2026-11-01

4) Who owns what
- LedgerWave: provide data, confirm redaction approach, procurement path (Samir + procurement).
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (Solutions Eng) — ingestion, baseline evals, result pack; Karthik — overall engagement and success criteria; Vanessa Ortiz — customer success and post-trial ops.

5) Data transfer options & security
- We can accept an AWS presigned S3 upload, or you can share via secure SFTP. I’ve attached a short S3 instruction PDF with the schema we expect. If you need an NDA addendum before transfer, let me know and I’ll loop legal.

Attachments: redwood_s3_instructions.pdf (schema + example), prompt_sample_template.csv (CSV header example)

Ask: Can you confirm by EOD 10/09 that the sample delivery dates work and who will be the data owner? Once we have the sample, Marissa will run a small baseline (<= 24h) and share an eval matrix.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@ledgerwave.com>

Date: 2026-10-08T09:21:00Z
Subject: Re: LedgerWave trial: prompts & log handoff, evaluation gates and timeline

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- We can provide an initial sample of ~250 prompts (anonymized) and one week of logs by 10/13. Full 2-week logs and the S3 handoff will be ready by 10/18 as you requested.
- On redaction: we will replace emails and phone numbers with stable hashes, but we want to preserve conversation threading IDs for evaluation. OK?
- For success criteria: the product team is comfortable with the latency target but would like to see a short note in the eval report about how batching/QA tradeoffs affected latency vs. accuracy.
- Procurement will evaluate licenses and will likely need an NDA/SoW before full log transfer — they’re on copy.

I’m attaching a small sample CSV (ledgerwave_prompt_sample.csv) so you can validate the schema. If the schema is good, we’ll proceed with the rest of the logs.

Cheers,
Samir Patel
Senior Product Manager | LedgerWave
samir.patel@ledgerwave.com

---

On Thu, Oct 7, 2026 at 15:12 Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@ledgerwave.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-09T17:40:00Z
Subject: RE: LedgerWave trial: prompts & log handoff, evaluation gates and timeline

Samir — thanks for the sample, it looks good and the CSV validates against our template. A couple of operational notes and the intake checklist so everyone knows who’s doing what next: 

Intake checklist (what we’ll validate upon receipt)
- File type: CSV or NDJSON (one event per line)
- Required fields: event_timestamp (ISO8601), query_text, user_id_hash, intent_label (optional), conversation_id (if available)
- PII: confirm stable hashing for the same user across rows (we’ll need this to approximate user-level metrics)

S3 handoff instructions (we’ll use your temporary bucket):
- Upload prefix: ledgerwave/poc/DW-4821/raw/
- File naming: logs_YYYYMMDD_partN.csv (avoid spaces)
- We will provide a temporary IAM role if you prefer not to presign; else presigned PUT urls are fine.

Evaluation plan (high-level)
- Baseline run (24–48h): ingest sample prompts + one week logs and run the baseline model (open model variant as discussed). We’ll compute intent macro-F1, false-positive rates for sensitive entities, latency p50/p95, and throughput headroom.
- Tuning window (one week): run 2 rounds of prompt tuning + quantized model variants as required.
- Final report: eval_matrix_template.xlsx (attached) will include per-intent breakouts, examples of failure cases, and recommended rollout (canary configuration + fallback model).

Owners and next actions
- LedgerWave deliverables: 2-week logs to S3 by 2026-10-18 (Samir + Procurement)
- Redwood deliverables: baseline results by 2026-10-21 (Marissa) and interim tuning notes by 2026-10-28 (Marissa + Karthik)
- CSM ops: Vanessa to schedule a brief post-readout call to walk through rollout options.

Small ask on the procurement timeline: if your procurement team can indicate whether they need an NDA vs full SoW before 10/15, that would help us schedule the ingest (we can do a masked ingest if needed).

I’ve attached the eval matrix template and the S3 instructions Karthik mentioned. I’ll start the baseline as soon as we have the first full-week log file uploaded.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
